claim_boundary: Internal fixture-backed validation for implemented+usable+validated maturity only; commercial-grade still requires external corpora, independent review, and trusted-tool diffs.

validated_items.title: Native EVTX BinXML full parsing
assertions: native_evtx_core_accuracy_gates records EventRecordID, file offset, provider/channel/EventID/computer pivots, duplicate EventData ordering, scalar type decoding, and unsupported grammar warnings.
fixture EVTX rows preserve source hash, record metadata, promoted EventData fields, and #1 core_accuracy_gates.
native EVTX collection uses mmap-bounded-record-scan plus streaming SHA256 instead of Path.read_bytes whole-file loading.
native chunk fixture covers matching header and events CRC32 validation.

validated_items.title: EVTX event template/message rendering
assertions: message_rendering provenance, fallback message text, parameter mapping, unresolved-template warning, and limitation disclosure are represented in #2 core_accuracy_gates.
curated provider message catalogs preserve source type, message ID, extraction tool, locale, catalog path, and template SHA256 provenance.
native EVTX rows can render from curated provider catalogs and remove the built-in-template fallback blocker for that row while retaining other commercial blockers.
Windows Event Manifest XML catalog fixtures resolve provider event message string references into rendered native EVTX messages with source_type=windows-event-manifest provenance.

validated_items.title: EVTX deleted/corrupt record recovery validation
assertions: eventlog-record-candidate rows preserve recovery status, candidate reason, offset/integrity context, caution labels, non-reportable default, and #3 core_accuracy_gates.

validated_items.title: Registry hive full key tree reconstruction
assertions: registry-key-tree-node rows preserve root reachability, parent-child backlinks, value-list ownership, last-write timestamp evidence, transaction-log disclosure, source hashes, and #4 core_accuracy_gates.

validated_items.title: Registry deleted key/value recovery
assertions: registry-key-recovery-candidate and registry-value-recovery-candidate rows preserve positive-size free-cell evidence, parent-key confirmation, data plausibility, allocator evidence, reportability blocking, and #5 core_accuracy_gates.
